correctness.rationale: The planar map and one-sided branch convention are explicit, with the all-left continuum N excluded. For each non-all-left length-n word, the Jacobian is a signed monomial product D P^{b_n} ... D P^{b_1}. For even right parity, its diagonal exponents are (n+S)/2 and (n-S)/2 with S=1+sum_{j=1}^{n-1} zeta_j; the parity-to-zeta map bijects even words with independent n-1 fair signs. Removing the all-left word subtracts the unique k=0 configuration from binomial(n-1,k). For odd parity the characteristic polynomial is lambda^2+2^n. Thus n>=2 real count 2^{n-1}-1, complex count 2^{n-1}, minimum positive normalized modulus 2^{1/n}, and the standard sign CLT gives conditional |Z|/2 and full half-atomic mixture. Independent finite exact word counts n=2..12 matched the binomial formula; this checks examples and cannot substitute for the sign bijection. Signed orientation, normalization per iterate, boundary and shorter periods are correctly scoped.
